steps.title: Analyze and Define Specifications
steps.description: Formulate mechanics for 'Cosmic Dodger', a dynamic 2D retro space dodging and shooting game featuring score progression, lives, collectibles, particle explosions, and immersive arcade-style retro feedback.

steps.title: Set up Root Level Settings Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Configure settings.gradle for AGP 8.3.2 compatibility. Standardize maven resource resolving strategies and set up root modules.

steps.title: Configure Root Level Gradle Rules
steps.description: Establish standard Android Application plugin definitions using version 8.3.2 to run on Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Implement App Level build.gradle Build Rules
steps.description: Apply compilation SDK targets (34), set dynamic packaging identifiers (com.cosmicdodger.app), and force strictly safe Java 1.8 compatibility parameters.

steps.title: Design Android Application Manifest File
steps.description: Ensure accurate XML namespace resolving, specify screen orientation lock to portrait layout parameters, handle launcher registration, and link standard Material.NoActionBar theme rules.

steps.title: Design Interactive Game Viewport XML UI Overlay
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout nesting the customized hardware accelerated GameView, customized Start Menu, HUD readout layouts, and GameOver triggers.

steps.title: Develop Game Controller Activity logic
steps.description: Construct MainActivity.java to bind active XML components, establish save configurations for best-record persisting, and route engine callbacks.

steps.title: Implement Core Custom Game Engine
steps.description: Develop GameView.java setting up the customized scrolling stars background array, projectile lists, asteroids entities, gold collection targets, and visual screen shake algorithms.

steps.title: Integrate Native Sound Synthesis & Rendering UI Engine
steps.description: Integrate low-latency audio using Android platform ToneGenerator loops, and write Canvas draw commands mapping detailed asteroid craters and modern spacecraft designs.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compiler & Build System Integrations
steps.description: Re-evaluate anonymous internal definitions, make sure lambdas or unauthorized syntax properties are avoided, and proceed with asset packing pipelines.

steps.title: Building Cosmic Dodger
steps.description: Trigger final APK compilation assembly, generate debug builds, and output compiled installation deliverables.
